// Type declarations for Fixture-Loaded v1.0.0
// Generated by MZ Plugin Studio

declare namespace Fixture_Loaded {
  interface Parameters {
    /** Text to show. */
    Label: string
    /** Count */
    Count: number
    /** Whether it shows. */
    Enabled: boolean
    /** No default. */
    Empty: string
    /** One point. */
    Pair: Record<string, unknown>
    /** Some points. */
    Points: unknown[]
    /** Some ids. */
    Ids: unknown[]
    /** Any values. */
    Items: unknown[]
    /** Nested. */
    Child: string
    /** --- Section --- */
    "--- Section ---": string
  }

  interface ShowLabelArgs {
    /** How often the label is shown. */
    times: number
    /** note */
    note: string
  }

}

// ==== case: generateReadme
# Fixture-Loaded

**Version:** 1.0.0 | **Author:** Example Author | **Target:** MZ

> Holds imported parameters of the wrong type

## Installation

1. Download `Fixture-Loaded.js`
2. Place it in your project's `js/plugins/` folder
3. Enable it in the Plugin Manager

## Dependencies

**Required plugins:**
- Fixture_Base

**Load order:** Must be placed after:
- Fixture_Core

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|-----------|------|---------|-------------|
| Label | string | Hello | Text to show. |
| Count | number | 7 | Count |
| Enabled | boolean | true | Whether it shows. |
| Empty | string |  | No default. |
| Pair | struct | {"x":"1"} | One point. |
| Points | array | [] | Some points. |
| Ids | array | ["1","2"] | Some ids. |
| Items | array | [] | Any values. |
| --- Section --- | string |  | --- Section --- |

## Plugin Commands

### Reset Label

Clears the label.

### Show Label

Shows the label.

**Arguments:**

| Argument | Type | Description |
|----------|------|-------------|
| Times | number | How often the label is shown. |
| note | string | note |

## Additional Information

Shows the label after the base plugin.

## More Information

https://example.invalid/loaded

---

*Generated by [MZ Plugin Studio](https://github.com/Wintersta7e/mz-plugin-studio)*

============================================================================
 Fixture-Loaded v1.0.0
 by Example Author
============================================================================

 Holds imported parameters of the wrong type

----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 Parameters
----------------------------------------------------------------------------

 Label (string)
   Text to show.
   Default: Hello

 Count (number, min: 0, max: 10, decimals: 2)
   Default: 7

 Enabled (boolean)
   Whether it shows.
   Default: true

 Empty (string)
   No default.

 Pair (struct<Point>)
   One point.
   Default: {"x":"1"}

 Points (struct<Point>[])
   Some points.
   Default: []

 Ids (number[])
   Some ids.
   Default: ["1","2"]

 Items (string[])
   Any values.
   Default: []

----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 Plugin Commands
----------------------------------------------------------------------------

 Reset Label
   Clears the label.

 Show Label
   Shows the label.
   Arguments:
     Times (number) - How often the label is shown.
     note (string)

----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 Structs
----------------------------------------------------------------------------

 Point
   Fields: x (number)

----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 Dependencies
----------------------------------------------------------------------------

 Required: Fixture_Base
 Load After: Fixture_Core

============================================================================
 Changelog
============================================================================

 v1.0.0 - Initial release
